fields.label: How do you want to collect payments?
options: One off payment — Sell your programme by single payment
In scheduled payments — Create subscriptions or sell classes with scheduled payments.

fields.label: Total price
fields.help: This is a total price that you want to get from enrolled clients. If you have payment plans set on the programme, it is used for reference only.

fields.label: Registration fee
fields.help: The Registration fee will be charged when the booking is created and will be added to the price of the programme or the first scheduled payment.

fields.label: Late bookings:
options: Disabled — Don’t allow bookings to be created after the class has started.
Manual confirmation required — All bookings that are created after the class has started will need to be approved manually.
Automatically confirmed — When enabled, any booking made after the class has started will be automatically approved, with the price calculated according to the aliquot settings.

fields.label: Aliquot price calculation settings
options: Automatically calculated — Aliquot price will be calculated from the number of remaining sessions in the class.
Calculated automatically by the number of days — Aliquot price is based on the number of remaining days in the current period and one full upcoming period.

No value — Bookings that will be paid in full will have zero debt/price calculated on them. Bookings that will be paid using scheduled payments won't have any debt calculated until the start of the next period. For example if period start on 10th in month and client registers on 11th, they won't get any price calculated until 10th of next month.

Full programme price — The price for the bookings will be always set at the full price, regardless of the date of the booking. Soeven if a client registers on the last day of the class the calculated price will be full programme price/scheduled payment.

fields.label: Billable sessions (leave empty if all are billable)
fields.help: Enter the number of sessions that will be paid. You can thus have any number of sessions in the class, but only the number entered by you will be paid. If you enter a value ""0"", the application will count all sessions in the class, regardless of their status (except deleted). In order for the setting to work correctly, indicate in the class which sessions are paid. The functionality is suitable for programmes in which a fixed number of sessions are sold and at the same time it is important that the client uses up the given sessions (e.g. individual language programmes).

fields.label: Payments are managed by registrant
fields.help: If selected and multiple bookings are submitted at once. Subsequent bookings debt will be transfered to first booking. If payment plan is created it is also created on the first booking only (with cumulative debt for all bookings). The registrant will receive one payment reference and one confirmation email.

cards.title: Change › Payment reminders settings
intro: The reminder setting applies to bookings that do not have a recorded payment for the programme. Sending them out works based on the settings below. Reminders will only be sent to bookings created after this setting has been activated.
Activation date for reminders: Sunday, 1. March 2026, 07:45:54

fields.label: Settings for sending payment reminders
options: Sending a reminder before the start of the programme — Select to send reminders before the programme starts. The due date for payments is equal to the start date of the class (the first session in the class).
Sending a reminder after the booking — Select if you want to send reminders only after bookings have been created.

fields.label: First reminder
fields.help: Enter the number of days following the booking when the first reminder should be sent.

fields.label: Second reminder
fields.help: Enter the number of days following the booking when the second reminder should be sent.

fields.label: Days from date of enroling when payment is due
fields.help: From this number the due date for payment reminder is calculated. It doesn't relate to first or second reminder so it can be set lower or higher, depending on your need.

fields.label: Delete an unpaid booking after the booking has signed up for a programme
fields.help: Unpaid bookings will be deleted after the time specified by you following their creation and booking for a programme.
options: Delete all unpaid bookings — Applies only to enrolled bookings with status Unpaid, Down payment unpaid, or Final payment unpaid. Bookings that are partially paid will not be deleted.
Without down payment — Applies only to enrolled bookings with status Down payment unpaid.

fields.label: Move bookings without a down payment to the waitlist
fields.help: Moves the booking to the waitlist if the down payment hasn't been paid by the due date.

fields.label: The setting will only be valid for new bookings
fields.help: Select this option if you want the deletion of unpaid bookings to be applied only to new bookings.

notes: Booking will be able to be completed and paid in cash at a later date.
